moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio press-feedback, written here): Button (132×46, r 14) presses: scale 1 → 0.94 in 120 ms power2.out, holds 60 ms, back to 1 in 300 ms power2.out; its under-slab depth (6 px) and drop shadow fall to 25 % while pressed and return with it. A cursor glides in (450 ms) and clicks. Params: scale (0.94) · down (0.12 s) · up (0.3 s) · shadow (25 %).
